display_title: I Married a Virgin Pervert Duke
description:
Liria, the fourth princess of Lession, approaches the young Duke Evan Blake to avoid a forced marriage to an elderly foreign king. Evan is a brilliant noble who rose rapidly through merit in both civil and military affairs—but Liria soon discovers that beneath his flawless exterior lies a shockingly eccentric personality. As their unexpected marriage unfolds, Liria is left questioning whether choosing him was truly the right decision.
